title: 书面表达的准确程度
goal: 选择符合短文语域的表达；保留原意中的范围和判断程度。

points.label: 选择符合短文语域的表达
保留原意中的范围和判断程度

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 书面论述要写明对象，评价要具体，判断的程度要恰当。正式论述通常用完整形式，不用口语缩写。缩写本身并不是语法错误。改写时保留原句的否定、可能性和适用范围。

body.box: The plan can’t cover every case. → The plan cannot cover every case.

body.p: 含混的判断要靠写出依据来改，不靠换成华丽的词。The guide is good. 如果依据是步骤清楚，就写成 The guide explains each step clearly. 没有依据时，不自行补上效果优异之类的评价。

cards.title: 中性评价
rows: 缩写与具体性
保留否定，再说明评价依据。
Context: The map omits the back entrance. Informal: It isn’t good. Precise: The map does not show the back entrance.
笼统赞美
写出看得到的特点，不加强程度。
Context: Labels name each control. Vague: The panel is great. Precise: The panel identifies each control clearly.
含混名词
用已给出的对象替换 stuff 等泛称。
Context: Missing cost figures. Vague: The report lacks some stuff. Precise: The report lacks the cost figures.
情绪评价
用材料中的事实代替带情绪的判断。
Context: No explanation of rejected requests. Informal: The reply is useless. Precise: The reply does not explain why the requests were rejected.

cards.title: 范围限定
rows: some
部分不能改成全部或大多数。
Original: Some users need guidance. Revision: Guidance is necessary for certain users.
in this trial
单次试用不能推出所有场景。
Original: The method worked in this trial. Revision: The trial showed a successful use of the method.
under these conditions
改写后仍保留条件。
Original: The coating lasts under dry conditions. Revision: In a dry environment, the coating remains durable.
not all
not all 是有一部分不，不是全部不。
Original: Not all requests were approved. Revision: At least some requests were not approved.

cards.title: 语气强弱
rows: may
可能性不能改为必然结果。
Original: The reminder may reduce delays. Revision: The reminder could help reduce delays.
tends to
tends to 表示多数情况如此，不写成总是如此。
Original: The layout tends to slow entry. Revision: Entry is generally slower with this layout.
should
should 表示建议，不写成已经发生的事。
Original: The office should review the rule. Revision: A review of the rule is advisable.
must
明确要求不能弱化为可选建议。
Original: Staff must record each loan. Revision: Recording each loan is required of staff.

body.box: A draft describes a trial sign as “really good” and says it “will solve everyone’s problems.” The recorded observation is narrower: several first-time visitors used the sign to locate the reception desk without asking for help. A precise revision should name that function, retain the limited group, and avoid turning an observation into a universal prediction. “The sign helped several first-time visitors locate reception independently” expresses the recorded benefit. It does not claim that the sign removes every difficulty for every visitor.

Which change preserves the evidence?
1. Replace several with all to make the evaluation clearer.
2. Describe every visitor’s future experience as certain.
3. Replace the observed benefit with a general expression of approval.
4. Name independent wayfinding and retain several first-time visitors.

body.p: 第四项保留了观察对象、具体作用和范围。several 限定人数，helped 说的是已经观察到的作用，改写时都要保留。正式表达不需要扩大结论。

items.stem: Observation: The index lists topics but omits page numbers. Which revision makes “The index is bad” precise?
options: The index does not provide page numbers for the listed topics.
The index is a remarkably bad resource for every possible topic.
The index is not good and is probably bad for everyone.
The index provides no topics or page numbers of any kind.
items.why: omits page numbers 指出了具体的不足，第一项照此改写。第四项连已列出的 topics 也否定了。

items.stem: Original: Some participants may prefer a written explanation. Which revision preserves both limits?
options: A written explanation is preferable for every participant.
A written explanation could be preferable for certain participants.
Every participant must prefer receiving a written explanation.
No participant is likely to prefer a written explanation.
items.why: Some 对应 certain，may 对应 could。第二项两处限定都保留了。

items.stem: The note identifies the required documents. Which revision of “This stuff is useful” names the observed function?
options: The documents are good because they are useful stuff.
The note establishes that every submitted document is sufficient.
The note specifies which documents are required.
The note proves that no further documents could ever be needed.
items.why: identifies the required documents 对应第三项的 specifies which documents are required。

items.stem: Original: Not all of the suggested changes were adopted. Which restatement is equivalent?
options: None of the suggested changes were adopted.
All of the suggested changes were adopted.
Exactly half of the suggested changes were adopted.
At least some suggested changes were not adopted.
items.why: Not all 只说明至少有一部分没有采用，即第四项。第一项把它改成了全部没有采用。

items.stem: Replace a vague negative evaluation with the observed omission of an explanation.
items.why: 正式论述用完整形式 does not，不用 doesn’t。provide an explanation of 指出缺少的是说明。

items.stem: Name the function that makes an illustrated guide useful.
items.why: provides a clear description of each stage 写出了指南的具体作用，比 great stuff 具体。

items.stem: Keep a possibility limited to a subset of users.
items.why: may 限定可能性，some users 限定范围。

items.stem: Retain an obligation without turning it into optional advice.
items.why: requires staff to record 表示明确的要求。换成 suggests 就成了建议，强度变弱。

items.stem: The evidence says a notice names the collection point but omits the collection date. Which formal revision makes “The notice isn’t good” specific?
options: The notice identifies the collection point but does not state the collection date.
The notice is an extremely poor document that gives no useful collection information.
The notice identifies every collection detail needed by everyone who plans to attend.
The notice is not good because the collection information is just not good enough.
items.why: names the collection point 和 omits the collection date 两点，第一项都保留了。第二项改成了没有任何有用信息。

items.stem: Original: The new schedule may reduce waiting for some afternoon visitors. Which revision preserves both uncertainty and the limited group?
options: All afternoon visitors will face a shorter wait under the new schedule.
Certain afternoon visitors could face a shorter wait under the new schedule.
Certain morning visitors must face no wait under the new schedule.
No afternoon visitor can face a shorter wait under the new schedule.
items.why: may 对应 could，some afternoon visitors 对应 certain afternoon visitors，即第二项。

items.stem: The draft calls a comparison “great.” The stated reason is that it separates initial cost from continuing cost. Which revision is precise without adding an outcome?
options: The comparison is extraordinarily great because its discussion of costs is very good.
The comparison proves that initial expenses are always lower than continuing costs over time.
The comparison distinguishes the initial expense from the costs that continue over time.
The comparison guarantees that choosing the lowest initial expense eliminates every continuing cost.
items.why: separates initial cost from continuing cost 对应第三项的 distinguishes。第二项加上了哪类成本更低的结论，原句没有这个意思。

items.stem: Original: Staff must obtain approval before changing the shared record. Which revision preserves the obligation and its timing?
options: Approval is advisable after staff make a change to the shared record.
Approval may be obtained whenever staff find it convenient to change the record.
Approval is optional if staff have already made a change to the record.
Approval is required before staff make a change to the shared record.
items.why: must 对应 is required，before 保留了时间要求，即第四项。第一项把要求改成了建议，时间也改到了之后。

items.stem: Express the observed limitation in complete formal wording rather than a contraction or vague criticism.
items.tail: that were presented to the committee during its review of the proposal.
items.why: does not 是完整形式。the basis for the difference 写明了缺少的内容。

items.stem: Specify what a list contributes rather than describing it with a general word of praise.
items.tail: to the program that accepts proposals from local organizations each spring.
items.why: identifies the documents 写出清单的具体作用，不用 is great about 这样笼统的赞美。

items.stem: Preserve the original possibility for a restricted group without converting it into a prediction about everyone.
items.tail: because their other commitments prevent them from attending during the usual period.
items.why: may 保留了可能性，participants who need access 限定了人群。will benefit everyone who 会把它变成对所有人的必然结果。

items.stem: Keep the observed finding limited to the trial described in the body of the report.
items.tail: and has not yet been demonstrated under the other conditions now being considered.
items.why: was observed in the trial 把发现限定在这次试验中，不写成 is guaranteed everywhere。
